scope: Actual React GalleryView and CollectedPaletteView compiled by Vite SSR and mounted with React DOM in JSDOM; real file-backed SVG fetch; no component test doubles.

checks.name: Knowledge: four colour controls share one fetch, exact SVG/download bytes and correct background
Gallery: old Knowledge EPS link without logos opens correct collection and palette
Gallery: old Knowledge SVG link without logos opens correct collection and palette
Gallery: old Knowledge PNG link without logos opens correct collection and palette
Gallery: old Northern Health black source opens shared tagline master in black
Gallery: old StrongerBC RGB reverse opens correct shared vector palette
Gallery: old StrongerBC Solid reverse opens correct shared vector palette
Palette loading: failed request has no stale download and retry loads real SVG
Gallery navigation: leaving a white Knowledge palette clears colour before Northern Health opens
Gallery reload: explicit selected colour overrides old-source alias and survives remount

limitations: JSDOM does not validate physical browser layout, font rendering, image decode, or an actual browser download to disk.
Network fetch is replaced by reading the real SVG files from the repository public directory; source bodies, palette transform, React components and event handlers are real.
The SSR bundle is used as a browser-module compilation route; this is not a server-rendered-page assertion.
This does not replace desktop/mobile browser visual acceptance.
